name: Coin Dash
tagline: Grab more coins than anyone else!
rules: Run around the arena and grab the coins.
Dash for a quick burst of speed (it needs a moment to recharge).
Most coins when time's up wins.

controls.keyboard: WASD / Arrows to run · Space to dash
controls.touch: Left stick to run · DASH button to dash
controls.gamepad: Left stick to run · A to dash
